answer_1.quote: Vision-language models (VLMs) have revolutionized multimodal understanding, excelling at tasks like image captioning and visual reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses to questions about hidden content in images.

answer_2.quote: Accuracy (%) for recognizing hidden text (exact match) and objects (category-level correctness) is calculated.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluators manually verify responses to avoid ambiguities (e.g., partial matches or synonyms).
answer_4.guideline: Responses are verified based on exact match for text cases and category-level correctness for object cases.
